fields.name: period_from
fields.description: ISO date YYYY-MM-DD; lower bound for sighting date (inclusive)

fields.name: period_to
fields.description: ISO date YYYY-MM-DD; upper bound for sighting date (inclusive)

fields.name: search
fields.description: Free-text search applied as LIKE on note + recognizable_animals

fields.name: include_old
fields.description: When true, the list mixes in historical hand-maintained sightings (sighting_old) alongside the app sightings, ordered by date. Default off.

schemas.name: SightingsEntry
schemas.description: Sighting list entry — extends TypeSighting with response-side fields

fields.name: track_point_count
fields.description: Number of GPS tracking points the boat recorded during the sighting window (segment_count + 1 for source='tracking', omitted for manual_begin_end / no movement row). Lets the list-UI show which sightings actually have a real GPS track.

fields.name: is_old
fields.description: True when this entry comes from the hand-maintained historical table (sighting_old), not the app table. Drives the "old data" row badge + read-only in the list UI.

schemas.name: SightingSaveRequest
schemas.description: Save payload of the web sighting dialog. id > 0 updates that sighting, id = 0 creates a new one. The extended fields (photo_taken … other_species) are optional: left out, an update keeps the stored value.

fields.name: id
fields.description: Sighting id to update; 0 creates a new sighting.

fields.name: beaufort_wind
fields.description: Stored in beaufort_wind_n column. May contain decimals like "1.5".

fields.name: distance_coast_estimation_gps
fields.description: Position estimated without GPS: 1 yes, 0 no, -1 unknown.

fields.name: group_structure_id
fields.description: 0 not set, 1 widely dispersed, 2 dispersed, 3 loose, 4 tight.

fields.name: behaviours
fields.description: JSON id map of behavioural states, e.g. {"0":"2","1":"6"}.

fields.name: freq_behaviour
fields.description: JSON list of free-text tags, e.g. ["breaching","tailslaps"].

fields.name: other_species
fields.description: JSON id map of further species, e.g. {"0":"3"}.

schemas.name: SightingHistoryEntry
schemas.description: One changed field (or a create / delete event) from the history table.

fields.name: change_group
fields.description: Groups the fields changed by one save.

fields.name: field
fields.description: Column name; empty for a create / delete event without field.

schemas.description: Change history of a sighting, newest first.
